title: ApplicationCollaboration
description: An active structure element that names a grouping of two or more application components (or nested collaborations) which jointly perform collective behaviour. It is a logical or configured grouping of independently deployable parts, not a deployable unit or behaviour in its own right. Use ApplicationComponent instead when the symbol is a single modular, deployable unit, even if it internally composes sub-modules or calls other services. Use ApplicationInteraction instead when the symbol describes the joint behaviour itself, such as a message exchange, saga step sequence or protocol between components, rather than the group of participants. Use ApplicationProcess instead when the symbol is an ordered sequence of steps that achieves a result, even if those steps span several components. Use ApplicationService instead when the symbol is the externally exposed functionality the group offers rather than the group of participating components.

documentation.description: A free-text description of the collaboration that names its participating components and the joint purpose they serve. Set it whenever the element name alone does not make membership or purpose clear.

x-dr-evidence: a saga or choreography definition (e.g. Temporal/Camunda workflow config, event-flow manifest) that enumerates several named participating services under one collective name
a docker-compose file, Helm umbrella chart or Kubernetes namespace that groups multiple separately built services as one named subsystem delivering a shared capability
an architecture document, ADR or C4 diagram boundary that names a set of cooperating services (e.g. 'checkout subsystem: cart, pricing, payment') as a unit
